# eventsource-parser

Vendored ESM distribution of `eventsource-parser` 4.1.1 (MIT).
Source: https://github.com/rexxars/eventsource-parser

The unmodified `index.js`, `parse.js` and `errors.js` from the npm package are
served locally so production does not need Node or a third-party script CDN.
The upstream license is included in `LICENSE`.
